name: The Passage
developmental_beat: Birth: the last playable stage, ending in a cinematic.
plan_refs: DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md §6 (final stage is playable; birth as culmination)

obstacles.role: upper constriction leaving a low route
lower constriction paired with the upper one
last membrane; opens only when the overgrowth is defeated
obstacles.fallback_until_implemented: Use the implemented hide-on-defeat gate pattern from the Rot Bloom arena.

upgrade.name: Integrated form — combo mastery
upgrade.softlock_fallback: The final boss accepts any prior offensive unlock; the combo is mastery, not a required key.
upgrade.fallback_until_implemented: Use the existing spike burst for the finale until combo inputs are built.
upgrade.note: Birth is the culmination; no post-birth simulation is implied.

boss.name: The Last Overgrowth
boss.loop: A tangled cellular mass that alternates constriction and opening a soft core.
boss.weak_window: 1.6 s while the core is open between constrictions.
boss.softlock_fallback: The mother guides but never fights; energy regenerates, and the spike burst alone can finish the fight if later parts are absent.
boss.fallback_until_implemented: Use the Rot Bloom loop with a larger body and a final-hall backdrop.
boss.solution: Read the constriction rhythm, then spend any earned offensive unlock during the open core.

narrative.beat: Heartbeat and voice carry the player through the passage; after the membrane opens, birth plays as a cinematic — happiness with a little sadness.
